stem:
Two customers purchased coffee and doughnuts at a coffee shop. Each cup of coffee costs the same amount, and each doughnut costs the same amount.

• The first customer paid $4.90 for 1 cup of coffee and 2 doughnuts.

• The second customer paid $8.60 for 2 cups of coffee and 3 doughnuts.

What is the cost of 1 cup of coffee?
